notes.title: 🔮 Quality of Life Update Now Live - Fairies, New Buildings, and UI Scaling 🔮
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

We want to start by thanking you for your patience while we've been working to deliver the best possible experience with Fabledom's Patch 1.07. We've taken the necessary time to release a Beta version to address some last-minute issues and ensure a smoother, more enjoyable experience for everyone.

[b]A huge thank you as well to those who shared their save files during the Beta phase, your support has been invaluable in helping us fine-tune the game[/b]. Thank you again for your continued support and understanding. Now, let’s see the patch note and check out the exciting new changes!

[previewyoutube=jF3q137UPB0;full][/previewyoutube]

Following the announcement of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1651560/view/566995856081815376]Quality of Life update[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1651560/view/566995856081815376

We’re happy to announce a brand-new patch for Fabledom, packed with some fantastic quality-of-life improvements, including the addition of fairies to your kingdom, new buildings, and an option for UI scaling!

[h1][b]Patch Note:[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Fairies[/b][/h3]

[table noborder=1]
    [tr]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/e8243d63f40b74744e319963e1bdae1630c04b74.png[/img][/th]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/8b73c20f47d826f721328a4e2ed5965a8fd26865.png[/img][/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/2928f721772a549c411f33378278bbbb48b0ddfb.png[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/3e8ed672110a775a051f08f945d9b5b6edf60fbd.png[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Fairies are now part of your kingdom's residents and can be summoned using Prismatic Liquid. Here's what’s new:
[list]
[*] [b]Summoning Fairies[/b][/list]
To summon your first fairy, you’ll need 30 Prismatic Liquid. Each subsequent fairy will cost 30 more Prismatic Liquid than the last.

[h3][b]New Buildings[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/cf366fcbbc2e9d8dcfb61853e1a0ce43c2014176.png[/img]

[b]Fairy Tower[/b]

[u]Construction Cost:[/u]
[list]
[*] 800 Gold
[*] 100 Prismatic Liquid
[*] 150 Planks
[*] Upkeep: 20 Gold
[*] Capacity: Houses up to 5 Fairies
[*] Unlocks Fairies and allows the construction of Fairy Pillars.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/3e8ed672110a775a051f08f945d9b5b6edf60fbd.png[/img]

[b]Fairy Pillars[/b]

[u]Construction Cost:[/u]
[list]
[*] 400 Gold
[*] 50 Prismatic Liquid
[*] 80 Planks
[*] Upkeep: 10 Gold
[*] Allows summoning of more fairies and expands the operating radius of fairies.
[*] Destroying a Fairy Pillar will kill all housed fairies.
[/list]
[h3][b]UI Scaling[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/b91727d46b18f189c379d66136c9decd1fe94f33.png[/img]

We’re introducing a new option for UI scaling in the settings! You can now adjust the UI size from 0% (default Fabledom UI size) to +15%. Please note that due to varying monitor sizes and settings, some overlaps may occur. We will be monitoring your feedback and fine-tuning this feature in future updates.

[h3][b]A Huge Thank You![/b][/h3]

We want to extend our heartfelt [b]thanks to all 500,000 of our players for being part of the Fabledom community[/b]. Your support and feedback continue to inspire us as we work hard to make the game even better!

Stay tuned for more updates, and thanks again for playing! We can’t wait to hear your feedback!

notes.title: 🧚‍♀️ Quality of Life update - Fairies, New Buildings, and UI Scaling! 🔮
notes.content:
Greetings Princesses & Princes, it's been a while since your Kingdoms have seen the light of an update but it's almost time!

Last July's 1.06 patch was supposed to be the last patch for Fabledom however… Your enthusiasm and love for the game made us reflect on our decision to stop post-release support and we have not one but two [b]Quality of Life update coming up[/b]! While Grenaa Games oversaw their development, this would not have been possible without the help of Fabledom's Game Designer, Hippolyte Azalbert, and our friends at Celsius Online spearheading the development! So, without further ado, let's start with the first Quality of life update as more detail will be coming up later about the 2nd one.
 
A magical [b]new update[/b] will arrive in your kingdom on [b]March 26th[/b]! Get ready for Fairies, UI scaling, and brand-new buildings to enhance your kingdom. Here’s what’s in store: 

[b][h2]🧚‍ UI Scaling[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/448751cae0b7b46d20302d4d3a0a07bde1cc2241.gif[/img]

The long-awaited UI scaling feature is almost here! You will be able to adjust the user interface to perfectly fit larger screens, enhancing your Fabledom experience. 

[h2]🔮 [b]New Inhabitants - Fairies![/b] [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/92261acc6dc6992ee70380b95a1385e3c90d0525.gif[/img]

Meet the Fairies, mystical creatures ready to transport goods across your realm! Unlike your Fablings, they don’t need food or sleep, making them incredibly efficient. But their magic comes at a price, they’ll only work for those who provide Prismatic Liquid and grand Fairy Towers! 

Fairies are most useful in the late game, freeing up your Fablings to focus on other tasks, whether it’s working the fields or relaxing at home! 

[h2]🧚‍ [b]New Buildings: Fairy Tower & Fairy Pillars[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/d135f31e98cf19fd4c8bfcb93dcc2a2cc5439e75.gif[/img]
[b]Fairy Tower[/b]: The Fairy Tower is a unique building that can house up to 5 Fairies. It will help you transport resources within a radius around the tower. This building costs a large amount of Gold, Prismatic Liquid, Planks and requires upkeep.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/a0857174b54e70abd8afd12eb1876d4337f8216b.gif[/img]
[b]Fairy Pillars[/b]: Smaller than the Fairy Tower, Fairy Pillars accommodate up to 2 additional Fairies. These can be placed anywhere and transport resources within their radius. This building costs about half as much as the Tower.

[h2]🔮 [b]Prismatic Liquid[/b][/h2]

To summon Fairies, you’ll need to gather Prismatic Liquid. Once you have enough, these magical creatures will be ready to streamline your resource transport and leave your Fablings to handle other tasks! 

[h2]🎮 [b]Console Update Coming Soon [/b][/h2]

The [b]patch will be coming to consoles later[/b]. More information will be available in the coming months! 

We hope you will enjoy these exciting new features and improvements in Fabledom. We can’t wait to see how the Fairies help shape your kingdom! Stay tuned for even more updates soon.

notes.title: 🏰 Patch 1.06 🏰
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/d67a539c98c3c550baf010d7fb03b069646dcfb0.jpg[/img]

[h1]🏰 Patch 1.06 Is Available Now 🏰[/h1]

[h2]📝 Dev Notes 📝[/h2]
Patch 1.06 is expected to be the final patch for Fabledom. Thank you for your support from Early Access to the 1.0 release. We're happy to have you in our community!

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[h3]🎃 FINALLY FINALLY! A Giant Pumpkin and a Puppy in the Dog House 🐶[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/c54289c29e86f5e4ec04b07588c571c05ee601dc.png[/img]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where flag lines wouldn't spawn after construction completed and wouldn't play the placing animation if one of the connection points was marked as loaded.
[*] Fixed issue where loading a save would break flag lines' animation.
[*] Fixed issue where relocating wouldn't reset flag lines properly.
[*] Fixed some particle effects that were playing on load even though the game starts paused.
[*] Fixed construction progress shader not being affected by cloud shadows and appearing radioactive during winter.
[*] Fixed some missions showing a negative relationship effect that shouldn't have.
[*] Fixed emissary gnomes event having strange option titles.
[*] Fixed issue where missions with no expiration would show a strange tooltip.
[*] Fixed issue where locked resources would not be removed when a player throws a wedding.
[*] Added restriction on mass destruction of palaces.
[*] Added flagline connection points to townhouse well and regular well.
[*] Fixed issue where prismatic liquid could sometimes be covered in grass.
[*] Fixed issue where buildings wouldn't display their effect range on placement begin, only after being moved by a certain amount.
[*] Removed the feedback button (For future bug issues, please write on [url=https://discord.gg/EmThNMqc26]Discord[/url] or in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1651560/discussions/]Steam discussions[/url]).
[*] Fixed issue where musical garden ground wouldn't enable.
[*] Fixed issue where clock tower grass would clip.
[*] Fixed issue where decorations with foundations wouldn't be displayed before being constructed.
[*] Fixed lack of construction ground texture in:
[olist]
[*] Stockpile
[*] Market
[*] Barracks
[*] Wood bridge
[*] Stone bridge
[/olist] [*] Fixed banks, arc of pigs, flower queen, musical garden and ancient stone guardian using incorrect construction poles.
[*] Fixed farm and hospital not having water drop effects.
[*] Fixed issue where military overview UI of huge armies would overlap other panels.
[*] Fixed windmill missing windows.
[*] Fixed several models (added rain and frost effects).
[*] Fixed harvest guild decorations clipping through walls.
[*] Fixed sign post floating.
[*] Fixed issue where Dark Knight's third date wouldn't update properly if fortification level was already at 10.
[*] Fixed issue where Ramone's third date would subtract too much happiness.
[*] Fixed major issue with happiness where having trolls or dragon active while receiving other happiness bonuses would add their debuff one more time, stacking each time. This fix also addresses old saves affected by the bug.
[*] Fixed Bob not being red.
[*] Fixed Bob's branches being white.
[*] Fixed maze garden not having ground texture.
[*] Fixed grass capturing issue on load.
[/list]
[h2]Optimisations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a memory leak related to grass around trees and accessing mesh data for construction.
[*] Resolved memory access leaks associated with flag lines.
[*] Optimized the rendering process for large amounts of areas simultaneously.
[*] Heavily optimized the logic for drawing areas (preview area).
[*] Fixed an area rendering issue that caused overdraw on map edges.
[*] Optimized shadow casting for certain objects.
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a setting to toggle muting audio on focus lost, addressing issues where players experienced no sound.
[*] Notifications are now colour-coded for improved clarity.
[/list]
Thank you!

Greetings, old and new heirs,

A PIG PIG PIG PIG PIG thanks (sorry we have to say it 5 times) for all of your love, support and feedback during the early access of Fabledom. All of you in this community, have contributed to the development of the game and made it better.

Hello dear players,

It feels a bit surreal to finally ship 1.0, it's been almost 4 years since I started working in my spare time on what is now Fabledom, I am so grateful to have been joined by some incredible people along the way, each one of them has made the game much better than I could have ever made it on my own. A special thanks to our artist, Joao, who has been with me since long before we even had financing.

I also feel really indebted and grateful to our wonderful community on Discord, who have been crucial to the development of the game, and a special thanks to our moderators Shannon and Curtis (Chompers) for helping out!

I look forward to welcoming new players during our release and I already have plans for our first patches to bring some additional improvements, mainly in quality of life and performance!

notes.content:

Dear Princesses & Princes,

We've been working so hard preparing for the 1.0 release. We are excited to share some more information with you, you can read part 1 of the devlog [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1651560/view/4205874461260634333]here[/url]!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1651560/view/4205874461260634333
[hr][/hr] [h3]🐷 Achievements 🐷[/h3]

FINALLY FINALLY! The achievements will be available in the 1.0. Let's see if you can unlock them all as some of them they are actually quite difficult. Are you up to the challenge? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/31b103373cb6cfecc281aa3bb9b1011af83067de.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr] [h3]☠ Challenging or Cozy💺 IT'S UP TO YOU![/h3]

In 1.0, we will add 4 difficulty levels: Calm 🐷, Classic 🐷, Challenge 😅 and Cruel ☠!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/b02d9743cc498406dd2cd82934ad81dd8d2537fa.png[/img]

The Classic difficulty is the one we are used to from EA. If you hover your mouse over the checkbox next to each difficulty, you'll see the change in values compared to the Classic, such as family aid cost, soldier health, hunger, extra winter days, yearly nobility and whether or not there's helpful gifts.

Our idea is to allow players to have different kinds of play style, whether you want to have a cozy & chill experience, or whether you want to have a challenging experience in managing your fablings. It's ALL UP TO YOU!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/fe069a69b46857f70e7cac7104fec93016a958f9.png[/img]
[hr][/hr] [h3]📖 Localization 📖[/h3]
Thanks for your feedback & support, we decided to add Japanese localization!

[h3]🎮 UI & Quality of Life 🎮[/h3]
We've been focusing on improving the overall gaming experience. In 1.0, we've refined the world map UI for smoother navigation and reworked the categorization of structures for better organization. 

We have also improved the resource management by allowing players to lock resources in stockpiles and granaries. And the marketplace will now be able to pick up resources from these two locations.

Military units and foundations will no longer block each other. We've also tweaked the UI to make military control easier than before. And XP will be awarded to the hero when missions are completed. 

We've also implemented and addressed several issues reported in previous versions, as well as implemented features suggested by the community, like being able to view the amount of residents/workers in a building more easily, new chapter prompts, additional letters for all rulers,  and much more!

We should also mention that the audio systems have seen massive improvements, and we have added several new ambiances and other effects to improve immersion! 

[hr][/hr] [h3]✨ New Encounter ✨[/h3]

Eric, the misunderstood cyclops, is joined by his son "Eric Junior", though let's not spoil what this encounter is like quite yet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/b1ce1635912ff88ce9bc9b47ac291312c9162434.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr] [h3]🏫 New Decorations 🏫[/h3]

We also added some fancy new decorations! 😊

notes.title: Fabledom 1.0 - Dev Diary #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/772efd4f1c25cb39277504fa22fdae3b2c98c7cc.jpg[/img]

Dear Princesses & Princes,

1.0 is coming on May 13 and we have been so excited to share the new content with you in detail. So, without further ado, let's get started!

[h2]🗿 Troll Invasions 🗿[/h2]

We have a new threat to our kingdoms, the trolls. Actually, to get them into the kingdom, the prerequisite is to build a Mystic Mine, which can help you to earn coins at the expense of the trolls' appearance. If you wanna get rid of the trolls, you know what to do! 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/e437afee2855f4fca5e29003ee664dc761364958.gif[/img]

If you're willing to accept the challenge, the size of the troll invasions will depend on the amount of fortifications in your kingdom!

When a troll camp spawns, it will decrease the global happiness of your realm. If more active troll camps appear, the debuff value will increase! The only way to clear the debuff is to defeat the trolls!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/6c8d6f9147b1d17cd18d707810ec6452699d8a30.gif[/img]

New defensive weapons such as the Ballista, Cannon & Mortar will also be available! They're actually attached to the tower and each shot consumes 1 or 2 prismatic liquid, depending on the weapon that you're using!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/90556386692163c134f815c5b2b46153fbbad1e5.gif[/img]

[h2]🏹 New Army Management & Fortifications 🧱[/h2]

Fergus will now provide a buff to all fablings according to his level, that will let them carry more resources! 

Once you build a Mystic mine, you unlock another new feature; "Fortification". The more walls, towers and defensive weapons you have, the higher the value gets. This means a few things:

[olist]
[*] Bonus coin from Mystic mine is increased.
[*] Troll invasion sizes are increased.
[*] Rewards for defeating trolls are increased.
[/olist] 
So, if you want higher bonuses and rewards, you need to take more risk!

[h2] 🌟 Fantastical Disasters 🌟[/h2]

[h3]🐲 Flying Dragon 🐲 [/h3]

Our fablings are so scared of the gigantic beast... 

There will be special events where the dragon will spawn with a debuff for your Kingdom! 

You can give it what it wants to make it leave, or attack it with your ballistas! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/e9ae207fa491e231eaa275b88d24db471e5e6271.gif[/img]

[h3]🔮 The 3 witches 🔮[/h3]

Like the dragon, they will spawn with debuffs to your realm! Spend your nobility to get them out of the door or ... take your time and make your decision! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/23d238ba7dbda5d44d810360159b28c040c7c4c6.gif[/img]

[h2]💌 Start courting with the New rulers 💌[/h2]

[h3]🧰 Farrah, The Tinker Princess 🔨 [/h3]

Farrah, the Tinker Princess who has a passion for industry and production. Let's start developing a relationship with Farrah! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/5f68a39582e8c7c99e010e080efb52792b901d83.jpg[/img]

Build a Tinkers guild to speed up the production by giving the guild some particular resources!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/08a71940a936eb86e4c2543ec69d51c23c00df2f.png[/img]

You can also build a regenerator to regenerate resources in iron and stone deposits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/7147d3137ab26b05c580a3d3da090c00f47254a6.gif[/img]

[h3]🗡 Sir Payne, the Dark Knight 🖤[/h3]

Sir Payne, a cold Dark Knight, who enjoys suffering ... The gift of coal will absolutely warm his dark heart. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/4115b7544b629a828287867d029190b22a84cfdb.gif[/img]

By starting a relationship with Sir Payne, some courting gifts will be given! For example, the Strategic Council, where you can pay in coin and receive the [i]Combat Intelligence[/i] buff, which reduces the health of all enemies by a percentage (depending on how much you invest)! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/73d80dadbb3a26896a36a33d39def767158ad583.png[/img]

Also, Sir Payne will pay you for every fabling you imprison. It's up to you to decide who though! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/8a0b4cbb98aa2063f8367f92609b53d1cf02ce1e.png[/img]
[h2]🎭 New buildings 🎡[/h2]

In the 1.0, we also added a lot of new buildings for you to discover. It can take tons of resources to build a Mall, a Circus Tent, a Café, Arc of pigs or a Ferris Wheel... But at the end of the day, it's all about making your fablings happy! 

It's not finished yet! We'll be showing more new buildings and decorations in the next Dev Diary!

Thanks for reading! We'll see you euhhh, probably next week maybe? [url=https://fabledom.dearvillagers.com/]Wishlist now[/url] and stay tuned!

notes.title: Fabledom 1.0 content, price change & Spring Sale
notes.content:
Dear Princesses & Princes, 

Since Fabledom will be coming out of Early Access with the 1.0 update this spring, we'd like to give you an overall picture of what's going on!

[h2]Fabledom 1.0: What's the new content?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/a8a601504606ef0d9bbfa23178045b1fb1a11586.jpg[/img]

[h3]🗿 Troll Invasions 🗿[/h3] 
A new building, the "Mystic mine", that can generate great riches will also attract a new enemy. Trolls will settle in camps across your realm, it is your job to defeat them!

[h3]🔮 Fantastical disasters 🤯[/h3]
Prepare yourself for new events that will bring new fantastical creatures to your realm, unfortunately this time they are not very friendly. 

[h3]🤴 New rulers 👸[/h3]
It's finally time to meet the last 2 rulers in Fabledom; the Dark knight and the Tinker princess! As always, each ruler has unique buildings, items and objectives.

Adding to the above, the 1.0 will bring several QoL improvements, new buildings and more! Maybe some ballista or cannons mounted on those towers of yours?

We will be making dev blogs to explain the new features in detail! Stay tuned on Steam!

[h2] Price Increase [/h2]
It's been almost a year since Fabledom launched in Early Access! It has grown since then with 4 major updates, many patches of polish, quality of life improvements, optimizations and much more coming with the 1.0 launch later this spring! 

To recognize all the hard work that has gone into Fabledom, we've decided to increase its price from [u][b]15.99€/$ to 20.99€/$[/b][/u] starting after the end of the Spring Sale.

Dear princesses & princes,

The fairytale encounters can’t wait to meet you in the realm of Fabledom! The latest update – Fairytales & Community is now available!

Starting next week, the game will be [b]25% off[/b] for one week!  It's the perfect time to jump into the realm! And... don't go away! 

[b]A fan art contest[/b] will be launched tomorrow to celebrate the arrival of Halloween! Join the community as one of our princes or princesses! Stay tuned to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1651560/announcements/detail/3741985308808726292?snr=2_9_100003_]our news![/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1651560/announcements/detail/3741985308808726292?snr=2_9_100003_][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/c1333a976e7c4df912e077cc6f74282913395984.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3][b]Message from developer:[/b][/h3]
Finally! We have had a lot of fun working on this patch and it feels really nice to add a lot of QoL features we have been missing. The new content, especially all the new events and quests, have been a great addition, and we really believe players will enjoy it!

A huge thanks to our community for helping us identify all these QoL improvements and an extra big thanks to our Discord community, you are the best <3

Have fun my friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/bcd0f03dd4c978a304696d410db86899b091596e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Fairytale Encounters[/b][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[b]The misunderstood cyclops
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/5bddc0386031cdb24feb880d8b7bf696120237c0.jpg[/img]

Eric one-eye has a chance to visit your realm for a few days, and it is up to you if you want to fight him or befriend him. Rumor is he will stay and roam your realm if you end up as friends!

[b]Witches hut[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/5d33ef64ba7cf22c5fc4def6c77b329de028e956.png[/img]

You know her, you love to hate her, the witch is finally here in physical form. Why not visit her and see if you can’t get rid of her for good?

[b]Redhooded girl[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/306534108ecbbb0a7a14efccb92a8d69fabc144d.jpg[/img]

Will you help this poor girl find her grandma's house?

[b]Emissary gnomes[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/c72c2eb945bfceb4a3751f764928c7093c00433f.jpg[/img]

Visitors from another realm looking to improve their reputation, it’s up to you if you want to help them!

[b]Faun[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/81c5f67842c1d5f582d0637313396e4c532df5f9.png[/img]

The fluting faun has a chance to visit your realm, he loves to play his flute for trees and stones, perhaps his music can help somehow? 

And two more! Your turn to find them out!
[list]
[*] The Missing shoe
[*] The Wishing well
[/list] [/expand]

[h3][b]New world events and quests
[/b][/h3]
[expand type=details]
We have added over 50 new world events and 30 new objectives. Many follow a common thread and connect to each other, below are a few of our favourites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/ac48565bbbbf03dbd5208c2b39c17eaad9ff4fc5.gif[/img]

[b] Magic bean [/b]

A mysterious merchant visits your realm and offers you a magic bean or some very cheap food, surely feeding your fablings is a priority? But then again...

[b] Family matters [/b]

Sick of paying family aid? Finally, we get to hear from our parents and our dear sister, perhaps we can lower our costs a bit?

[b] Monthly objectives [/b]

It’s always nice to have some short-term goals, we have added over 20 new objectives that start via world events, each objective lasts 30 days.

[b] Yearly objectives [/b]

Long-term goals are also nice, we have added over 10 objectives that will last over 90 days, but the rewards are quite nice!

[b] Taking the good with the bad [/b]

We have added both positive and negative events, including a system that will add diminishing returns to event types, so you don’t need to worry about encountering all negative events. [/expand]

[h3][b]New Buildings
[/b][/h3]
[expand type=details]
We have of course added some new buildings as well, one of which is making a triumphant return!

[b] Laborer guild [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/e97e1bc7762725822393ece8169928822e67d5cc.png[/img]

[h3]Dear princes and princesses, [/h3]

As promised, we're finally here for the second devblog to talk about the fairytale encounters! For those who haven't read the previous one, you can check it out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1651560/announcements/detail/3682310076404099525?snr=2_9_100003_]here! [/url]

In the next update - Fairytales & Community - you'll find several new fairytale encounters, around 50 new world events, around 30 objectives and more new buildings. Let's dive in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/5d33ef64ba7cf22c5fc4def6c77b329de028e956.png[/img]

Princess & Princes,

I'm Terry, Community Developer of Dear Villagers. It is my honour to speak to all the princes and princesses about our next update - Gallantry & Bartering, coming on the 13th of July!

Today, Max, Game Director of Grenaa Games, is going to show you the ideas and inspiration behind these amazing features. 

[hr][/hr]

[h1]New level of inter-kingdom diplomacy![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/0562d7a11d1c0d938750ed08d2e0d7b10d2fa613.jpg[/img]
After placing the new Embassy, you will unlock the biggest new feature in this patch, the off-world missions. These missions have different rewards and require your help in one way or another.

"We are so glad that the missions are finally here, it has been a big part of our plan since day one and will be a mechanic that will evolve much more over time, eventually providing missions with unique rewards. Missions are a great way to get some use for your army while there is nothing to fight in your own realm."

Another system being introduced that is related to diplomacy is trading! It allows you to trade resources with a ruler while the relationship level has an impact on the exchange rate of goods.

While we are on the subject of trading, we might as well bring up our new world event "The traveling merchant" who will visit your kingdom regularly by offering a trade at a generous discount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/a83afdcff98a03f48246683907e4bc6b8ad5f07a.jpg[/img]

We are so excited to finally have our first content patch released! This patch is a bit special in that it’s a preparation for the next one, which will add a much clearer game loop and purpose for your hero and army. We are constantly fixing bugs and especially adding Chinese support due to the huge demand from Chinese speaking players! ^^ 

Here are the updates:
[b]- Support added for Simplified Chinese
- Fixed several issues with farm crops
- Fixed several placement issues
- Changed some collision data
- Road is now placed on last tile
- Typo fixes
- Small performance fixes
- Fixed several graphical issues
- Removed fishermans hut while taking a longer look at fixing some pathing issues caused by this feature.
- Fixed cursor icon sometimes getting stuck
- Fixed rare issue where you could get stuck on the last objective[/b]

With love,

notes.title: Patch Notes 🐷
notes.content:
Dear Princesses and Princes,

The game is updated. Here is our first patch notes:
[b]- Fixed UI scaling issue on different resolutions.
- Removed screenshot button.
- Added keybinds to rotate camera with keyboard.
- Added ability to rebind keys to the mouse.
- Solved issue where exiting game during winter and starting a new game would start the game with snow.
- Can now change kingdom name.
- Clothing now blows in the wind.
- Fixed issue where ground texture would update a bit randomly.
- Fixed territory view so overlay is rendered on hill.
- Added improved error logging for some extreme edge cases.
[/b]

Thank you for your support. 

With love,
